actual_scope: Compare the address length L of one #4174 production plan with that plan's p, and record whether L <= p is true there or only a hypothesis the constructor does not enforce.
scope_change_reason: PR #4904 left open whether L <= p holds for a real #4174 placement. The successive sixteenth walks are closed, and the sharp-window pair check is recorded. This package reads that one plan. It does not rerun the descriptor census, does not retune 1/6400, and does not claim a new kappa.
bottleneck_link: The sharp-density absorption r <= p/19200 uses L <= p. On the recorded production plan the inequality holds because the caller sets p = 6L. The same constructor accepts a layout with L > p, so the constant is not an invariant of every #4174 layout. The selected frontier is unchanged.
stop_rule: Stop after one production plan and one admitted layout with L > p. Do not iterate the 104864 batches, replay the repair tariff, or spend p^100.
